summary: Specifies a way to carry long addresses in the HOST-PORT part of FTP's data port command, so FTP can work with next-generation IP alternatives and perhaps other transports besides TCP. It is experimental. It was replaced by RFC 1639.

eli5.summary: The old FTP form had small boxes for an address. This memo makes room for longer addresses so it can work with bigger future networks.

questions: ftp operation over big address records
